name: MCPJam Backend LLM free-tier model refusals >25 subjects/h
description: WARN · More than 25 distinct free-tier subjects were refused an expensive model by the price gate this hour. Not a page.
A low rate is healthy — the gate is working. A burst means someone is probing it, or real free users want a model we should be letting them have.
TRIAGE — open View Query below, replace the last line with:
| summarize N=count(), Subjects=dcount(billingSubjectKey) by modelId | sort by N desc
one model dominating across many subjects → consider raising FREE_BUCKET_MAX_OUTPUT_USD_PER_M
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: the gate is the blast-radius cap for the next farming wave — a wave now shows up as a burst of refusals instead of a burst of spend. Counting SUBJECTS, not events, so one confused user retrying does not trip it.

WHY THIS THRESHOLD: PROVISIONAL. The event is hours old (1 emitted so far). 25 subjects/h is a guess at 'many people at once'; re-measure after a week (| summarize dcount(billingSubjectKey) by bin(_time,1h)) and reset to ~3x the p95 hour.

NOTE ON 'positive results': triggerAfterNPositiveResults is a DEBOUNCE (fire only after N consecutive positive checks). It makes a monitor slower, never louder; Axiom notifies once on entering the alert state and once on leaving. Page-vs-warn is decided by the notifier, not this field.
